papers.title: Evaluating Online Information Regarding the Direct Anterior Approach for Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Boston University School of Medicine, Boston, Massachusetts; University of California, San Francisco, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, San Francisco, California

corresponding_authors.name: Rohith Mohan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Boston University School of Medicine, Boston, Massachusetts; University of California, San Francisco, Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, San Francisco, California

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅评估全髋关节置换术在线患者教育信息的质量，不涉及任何生物力学或植入物设计内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve any biomechanical modeling, stress shielding analysis, micromotion quantification, or finite element simulation related to hip implants or femoral stems.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估直接前入路全髋关节置换术在线信息的质量
summary_zh.method: 使用标准化工具评估网站内容的可读性、准确性和完整性
summary_zh.result: 大多数网站信息质量较差，缺乏循证内容
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅对现有网站进行评分

summary_en.motivation: To assess the quality and readability of online patient education materials regarding the direct anterior approach for total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Standardized instruments were used to evaluate the accuracy, completeness, and readability of content from relevant websites.
summary_en.result: The majority of websites provided poor-quality information, often lacking evidence-based recommendations.
summary_en.validation: No experimental or clinical validation was performed; the study only scored existing online content.

papers.title: The Cost–Utility of Total Hip Arthroplasty: Earlier Intervention, Improved Economics
papers.first_author_affiliation: The Center for Advanced Orthopedics at Larkin Hospital South Miami, Florida

corresponding_authors.name: Carlos J. Lavernia
corresponding_authors.affiliation: The Center for Advanced Orthopedics at Larkin Hospital South Miami, Florida

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论全髋关节置换术的成本效益，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a health economics study with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding analysis, no micromotion quantification, and no FEA or implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术在不同年龄阶段的经济效益。
summary_zh.method: 使用成本效用分析模型比较不同手术时机。
summary_zh.result: 早期干预具有更好的成本效益。
summary_zh.validation: 基于文献数据的模型分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the cost-effectiveness of total hip arthroplasty across different age groups.
summary_en.method: A cost-utility analysis model was used to compare surgical timing.
summary_en.validation: Model analysis based on literature data.

papers.title: Does rotational acetabular osteotomy affect subsequent total hip arthroplasty?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kanazawa Medical University, 1-1 Daigaku, Uchinada-machi, Kahokugun, Ishikawa, 920-0293, Japan, 66406kf@kanazawa-med.ac.jp

corresponding_authors.name: Kiyokazu Fukui
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Kanazawa Medical University, 1-1 Daigaku, Uchinada-machi, Kahokugun, Ishikawa, 920-0293, Japan, 66406kf@kanazawa-med.ac.jp

papers.venue: Archives of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究旋转髋臼截骨术对后续全髋关节置换术的影响，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on acetabular osteotomy and its effect on subsequent THA, with no quantification of femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估旋转髋臼截骨术对后续全髋关节置换术的影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析接受RAO后行THA的患者临床和影像学数据
summary_zh.result: RAO可能增加THA手术难度但中期结果良好

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the impact of rotational acetabular osteotomy on the outcomes of subsequent total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of clinical and radiographic data from patients who underwent THA after prior RAO.
summary_en.result: RAO may increase surgical complexity but mid-term THA outcomes remain favorable.
summary_en.validation: Clinical case series with retrospective review.

papers.title: Femoral Neck Stress Shielding after Birmingham Mid Head Resection Hip Arthroplasty – Case Report and Literature Review
papers.first_author_affiliation: Brisbane Hip Clinic, St. Andrews War Memorial Hospital, Queensland, Australia and School of Medicine, Griffith University, Queensland, Australia and St Andrews War Memorial Hospital, Queensland, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Patrick Weinrauch
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Brisbane Hip Clinic, St. Andrews War Memorial Hospital, Queensland, Australia and School of Medicine, Griffith University, Queensland, Australia and St Andrews War Memorial Hospital, Queensland, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅通过病例报告和文献综述讨论Birmingham Mid Head Resection髋关节置换术后的股骨颈应力遮挡，未涉及股骨柄假体或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion with contact/friction modeling, and lacks patient-specific FE simulation or comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 报告Birmingham Mid Head Resection术后股骨颈应力遮挡的病例并综述文献。
summary_zh.method: 病例报告结合文献综述。
summary_zh.result: 描述了应力遮挡现象，但缺乏定量分析。
summary_zh.validation: 无验证，仅为病例描述和文献总结。

summary_en.motivation: To report a case of femoral neck stress shielding after Birmingham Mid Head Resection hip arthroplasty and review the relevant literature.
summary_en.method: A case report and literature review approach was adopted.
summary_en.result: The phenomenon of stress shielding was described qualitatively, but no quantitative biomechanical analysis was performed.
summary_en.validation: No validation was conducted; the study is based on a single case and literature summary.

papers.title: The process of improving the ability to implement active learning to meet educational competence development goals

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论教育领域的主动学习能力提升，与有限元代理建模完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about educational pedagogy, not about surrogate modeling, FEA, or any computational method for engineering design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升教育中主动学习能力以达成能力培养目标。
summary_zh.method: 探讨主动学习实施过程与能力发展的关系。
summary_zh.result: 提出改进主动学习实施的策略。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为理论探讨。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the ability to implement active learning for achieving educational competence development goals.
summary_en.method: The paper discusses the process of implementing active learning in education.
summary_en.result: Strategies for improving active learning implementation are proposed.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; theoretical discussion only.
